latest_constraints.open_input_requirement: Physical MCU ADC pin near 0 V, not merely input-equivalent zero
latest_constraints.normal_input: DC plus 60 Hz, -2 V to +2 V

current_circuit.topology: SMA -> 6.8k resistor -> summing node with 6.8k to REF3325 2.5V -> OPA320 follower -> 47ohm/2.2nF -> ADC

connector_to_ground_pulldown_calculation.assumptions: Ideal 2.5V reference and follower, 6.8k input and bias resistors, SMA unplugged, no other fitted DC return
connector_to_ground_pulldown_calculation.conclusion: A weak 100k/1M pulldown alone does not establish zero. A strong return heavily loads the source and still targets ADC 1.25V, not raw ADC 0V.

options.name: High-impedance bipolar input buffer before level shifting
options.effect: Weak GND return at the raw input plus a buffer prevents reference backfeed. Open and driven input 0V both approach ADC 1.25V/input-equivalent zero.
options.candidate: OPA197/OPA4197 supplied +3.3V/-3V; LM27761 could create regulated -3V from existing +5V
options.reason: Needs a new negative rail and does not make raw ADC pin zero on open
precision_caveats: OPA197 at +3.3/-3V has input-stage transition around input +0.3 to +1.8V; precision and noise require validation.
OPA197 bias current max over temperature can create 5mV across 1M; protection and PCB leakage add error.
OPA320 on 0/+3.3V cannot directly follow raw -2V.

options.name: Open detection plus ADC-path driver/GND selection
options.effect: Reserve raw ADC 0V as an unplugged-state output while preserving the normal bipolar-input transfer.
options.status: Candidate requiring threshold/source-impedance/fault/startup analysis; not implemented
constraints: Observe signal before the ADC-grounding switch to avoid self-latching.
Do not short an active amplifier output to GND; disconnect/select paths with an appropriate switch.
Voltage-threshold detection can confuse valid high-source-impedance inputs or overrange with an open connector.

unresolved_user_choices: Signal-source output impedance and worst-case range
Allowed measurement loading and absolute DC/60Hz error
Allowed open-detection delay, hysteresis and minimum separation from valid inputs
Required treatment of overrange, source power-off and startup
